vrev_lead: See what will run, what stays out and what prevents the run, before running. The plan is built when the screen opens.
vrev_concurrency_many: Up to {n} at the same time
vrev_reduced: This validation will be reduced: something the profile asks for was turned off for this run only. The result does not count as approval of the whole profile.
vrev_uncovered_none: No requirement was left without coverage.
vrev_unavailable_title: Tools that will not be able to run
vrev_unavailable_lead: Each instance below is in the plan, but has no way to run right now. While this holds, the result stays incomplete and is never approved.
vrev_tie_explain: decisions of the layer {layer} with the same specificity disagreed, and the tie was resolved to on.
vrev_tie_decisions: {winner} won; against: {others}. On is the safe side: in a tie, more runs, never less. To decide differently, make one of the selectors more specific or remove one of them.
vrev_changes_title: What changed since the last plan
vrev_changes_first: This is the first plan of this workspace.
vrev_changes_same: Nothing changed since the last plan.
vrev_changes_network_off: The network is no longer necessary
vrev_terminal_lead: The command below runs exactly this validation and produces a plan with the same identifier.
vrev_command_copy_failed: Could not copy; select the command text.
vrev_effect_outputs: Writes outputs to the run folder
vrev_blocker_template: Required template without a compatible component
vrev_blocker_architecture: Architecture included without an active rule
vrev_blocker_build: The plan could not be built
vrev_unsaved_message: {count} document(s) used by the plan have unsaved changes.
vrev_how_empty: Go back to Choose and leave at least one check on: choose another profile or undo the switch-offs of Customize this validation.
vrev_how_template: Add a component compatible with the template {template} (jgates.yml, components), or change its activation from always to detected or manual.
vrev_how_target: Go back to Choose and give the directory, the commit or the references of the target; the references must exist in this repository.
vrev_how_category: Turn on, in the profile or in the project, an executable check for each requirement, or undo the switch-offs of this run.
vrev_how_architecture: Declare at least one rule in .jgates/architecture.yml (Configuration, Architecture) and keep the architecture tool installed, or take architecture out of this profile.
vrev_how_config: Fix the indicated file in the tool editor (or save the valid draft) and build the plan again.
vrev_how_unsaved: Below, save each draft or choose to use the saved version; the plan only holds for one of them.
vrev_how_tool: Install the tool or point to its binary (jgates doctor shows what is missing and jgates tools prepare prepares what it can), or turn the check off in the profile.
vrev_how_version: Install a version within the adapter range (jgates doctor shows the range and the version found), or turn the check off in the profile.
vrev_how_eslint: Create an eslint.config in the component, or declare tools.eslint.config in .jgates/tools.yml pointing to the configuration file.
vrev_how_architecture_tool: Create .jgates/architecture.yml with at least one forbidden-dependency rule (or, in Python, keep a native Import Linter configuration), and install the tool.
vrev_how_tool_unavailable: Install the tool or point to its binary (jgates doctor shows what is missing), or turn the check off in the profile.
vrev_how_build: Check the message above, fix the configuration or the target and use Update plan.
vrev_how_network_denied: Allow the network in execution.network (jgates.yml) for the checks that ask for it, or turn those checks off.
